items.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
items.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission and UK universities
items.fields: Approved master's courses, many in health and development
items.funding: Full tuition, airfare, monthly stipend, thesis and travel grants
eligibility: Citizen of and resident in an eligible low or middle-income Commonwealth country
Not studied or worked a year or more in a high-income country
Apply to the university and through CSC Central
items.deadline_note: CSC applications open 10 November and close 8 December 2026, 16:00 GMT. Apply to the university too — each sets its own course deadline.
items.fit: For candidates who have not studied abroad before.

items.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027/28
items.fields: Any full-time postgraduate course at Cambridge
items.funding: Full cost: fees, maintenance, airfare, visa
eligibility: Apply for a full-time Cambridge course and tick the Gates box
Outstanding intellect, leadership and commitment to improving lives
items.deadline_note: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, depending on the course's funding deadline.
items.fit: MPhil or PhD in epidemiology or population health.

items.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – Cambridge
items.funding: Full tuition, maintenance allowance, programme support
items.deadline_note: Apply by your course's funding deadline: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027.
items.fit: Fully funded Cambridge MPhil for African applicants, including population health.

items.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program – University of Cape Town
items.provider: Mastercard Foundation / University of Cape Town
items.fields: Coursework master's in any faculty, including public health
items.funding: Comprehensive scholarship plus leadership and career support
eligibility: Must also apply to UCT for admission
items.deadline_note: Postgraduate applications close 31 October 2026.
items.fit: MPH, epidemiology or biostatistics while staying in Africa.

items.title: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships (Oxford) 2027/28
items.fields: Eligible Oxford courses, e.g. Global Health Science & Epidemiology, Social Data Science
items.funding: 100% of fees, living grant of at least £21,805, leadership programme
eligibility: Ordinarily resident in an eligible country (Ghana is eligible)
Apply to an eligible course by its deadline
items.deadline_note: Course deadlines run November–January. MSc Global Health Science & Epidemiology closes 12:00 UK time, 1 December 2026.
items.fit: Oxford epidemiology and data science MScs, open to Ghanaians.

items.title: Clarendon Scholarships (Oxford)
items.funding: Full fees and living grant
eligibility: Automatic consideration when you apply by the course deadline
items.deadline_note: No separate form. Global Health Science & Epidemiology and Modelling for Global Health close 12:00 UK time, 1 December 2026.
items.fit: No separate form — apply to the course and you are considered.

items.title: Mastercard Foundation AfOx Scholarship (Oxford MBA)
items.provider: Africa Oxford Initiative / Saïd Business School
items.funding: Full fees plus living grant of at least £21,805
items.deadline_note: Up to three awards.
items.fit: Only if moving towards health-tech or social enterprise leadership.

items.title: DAAD EPOS – MSc Development Economics (Göttingen)
items.funding: Monthly stipend, insurance, travel, German course
eligibility: Degree in the upper third, less than 6 years old
items.deadline_note: Window 1 October – 15 November 2026 for October 2027 entry.
items.fit: Econometrics-heavy degree for analysts moving towards health economics.

items.title: Europubhealth+ Erasmus Mundus Master in Public Health
items.funding: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: costs plus monthly allowance
items.deadline_note: Scholarship applications close 13:00 CET.
items.fit: Two-year public health master's with an epidemiology track.

items.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (catalogue)
items.fields: Search for data science, AI, infectious diseases, One Health, public health
items.funding: Participation costs plus about €1,400 a month
items.deadline_note: Most deadlines fall October 2026 – January 2027.
items.fit: Several programmes combine data science with health.

items.title: Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28
items.provider: Government of Hungary with Ghana Scholarships Secretariat
items.fields: Data science, computer science, public health and more
items.funding: Tuition, stipend, housing, insurance
eligibility: Master's 35 or under; PhD 45 or under
Second Class Upper, 2 years' experience, national service done
items.deadline_note: 2027/28 call not yet out; last year it opened mid-November. Ghanaians are nominated through the Ghana Scholarships Authority.
items.fit: Many English-taught data and health degrees.

items.title: Türkiye Bursları 2027
items.funding: Tuition, stipend, housing, insurance, flight, Turkish course
items.deadline_note: Usually 10 January – 20 February.
items.fit: One application covers many universities.

items.title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
items.fields: Public health, data science, sustainability and more
items.funding: Tuition, living allowance, travel grant, insurance
eligibility: Apply to the programme first, then to SI
items.deadline_note: University application by mid-January; SI application in February.
items.fit: Rewards work experience — suits a working analyst.

items.title: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
items.funding: Tuition, monthly allowance, airfare
eligibility: Born on or after 2 April 1992 (2027 round)
items.deadline_note: The 2027 embassy round closed in May 2026. Next embassy round is for 2028 entry; some universities run their own routes.
items.fit: Strong infectious disease modelling groups.

items.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (via Ghana Scholarships Authority)
items.funding: Tuition, housing, stipend, insurance
eligibility: Online application plus hard copies to the Secretariat
items.deadline_note: 2027/28 notice not yet posted. Last year's appeared on 5 November — watch the Authority's site.
items.fit: A common route into English-taught degrees.

items.title: Global Korea Scholarship – Graduate 2027
items.fields: All fields, including AI and data science
items.funding: Tuition, stipend, airfare, Korean course, insurance
items.deadline_note: Expect a February–March 2027 call.
items.fit: Strong AI and data science universities.

items.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship
items.funding: Tuition, living stipend, airfare, insurance
eligibility: National of an eligible developing country
items.deadline_note: Window 1 opens 18 January 2027; Window 2 runs 29 March – 21 May 2027.
items.fit: For professionals already working on public health.

items.title: AIMS Master's in Mathematical Sciences
items.where: Ghana, Rwanda, South Africa, Senegal, Cameroon
items.fields: Mathematical sciences, data science, AI, modelling
items.funding: Full: tuition, housing, meals, insurance
items.deadline_note: 2027/28 call not yet out. Last deadline was 15 March 2026.
items.fit: Builds the modelling skills behind malaria work — and AIMS Ghana is in-country.

items.title: Australia Awards Africa (2028 intake)
items.funding: Tuition, airfare, living allowance, health cover
eligibility: Citizen of an eligible African country
items.deadline_note: Opens February 2027.
items.fit: Depends on the 2028 priority areas.

items.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Ghana)
items.provider: US Department of State / US Embassy Accra
items.funding: Usually tuition, stipend, airfare, insurance
items.deadline_note: 2027/28 dates not confirmed — check the US Embassy Ghana page.
items.fit: US MPH or biostatistics programmes.

items.title: Pan African University Scholarships
items.funding: Full scholarship
eligibility: Strict age limits (e.g. master's: men 25, women 28)
items.deadline_note: 2027/28 call expected around mid-November 2026 (last year 15 November – 15 December).
items.fit: Fully funded African option if within the age limits.

items.title: Rhodes Scholarship (West Africa)
items.funding: Full fees, stipend, airfare, visa
items.deadline_note: Closed for 2027 entry. Reopens in 2027 for 2028.
items.fit: Plan ahead for the next cycle.

items.title: WHO Internship Programme
items.funding: Living allowance where needed; insurance
items.deadline_note: Rolling — each vacancy has its own deadline.
items.fit: Health-data internships at WHO AFRO or the Ghana office.

items.title: Forward-Deployed Data Analyst
items.where: Remote / travel to African health ministries
items.funding: Not stated
eligibility: French or Portuguese at B2 or above
At least 25% of the year in the project country
items.deadline_note: Still listed, no closing date. Projects include Malawi, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria, Mozambique.
items.fit: Working directly with ministries of health on their data.

items.title: UN Online Volunteering
items.funding: Unpaid
items.deadline_note: Ongoing.
items.fit: Adds UN assignments to a CV without relocating.

items.title: ALX Data Analytics
items.funding: Check cost on the enrolment page
eligibility: About 20 hours a week for 7 weeks
items.deadline_note: Start any time.
items.fit: SQL and Power BI credentials NGO roles ask for.

items.title: Data Science Africa Summer School
items.deadline_note: 2027 call expected early 2027.
items.fit: Pan-African school where health-data backgrounds stand out.

items.title: Deep Learning Indaba
items.funding: Fee waivers and limited travel grants
eligibility: Travel grants for those living in Africa
items.deadline_note: 2027 not yet announced (2026 aid closed in April).
items.fit: Africa's main machine learning gathering.

items.title: Outreachy Open-Source Internship
items.funding: USD 7,000 stipend for three months
items.deadline_note: December 2026 round is closed. The May 2027 round is not yet announced — join their announcement list.
items.fit: Paid remote internship that builds a public code record.

items.title: Zindi: Bias Bounty Mapping Equity Challenge
items.funding: USD 10,000 total
items.deadline_note: Closes 23:29 UTC.
items.fit: Uses spatial statistics skills.

items.title: MIT Solve 2027 Global Health Challenge
items.funding: USD 10,000 per team, plus larger prizes
items.deadline_note: Closes 12:00 EST.
items.fit: A health-data tool or dashboard could qualify.

items.title: ECA Innovation Café – African AI Innovations
items.fields: AI for health, agriculture, public services
items.funding: Showcase to policymakers
items.deadline_note: Apply before the 2 November event.
items.fit: Show a health-data or AI tool to policymakers in Accra.

items.title: D-Prize Challenge
items.fields: Distributing proven health and anti-poverty interventions
items.funding: Up to USD 20,000 seed funding
items.deadline_note: Early round 25 October; regular 15 November; final extension 6 December 2026 (midnight PT).
items.fit: A venture delivering malaria prevention in the Volta Region.

items.title: TEF Entrepreneurship Programme
items.funding: USD 5,000 seed capital, training, mentoring
items.deadline_note: Opens 1 January 2027, closes 1 March.
items.fit: Seed money to grow a data services business.

items.title: Oxford MSc Modelling for Global Health
items.funding: Clarendon or Weidenfeld-Hoffmann: full fees and living grant
eligibility: Apply to the course by the deadline — scholarships considered automatically
items.deadline_note: Closes 12:00 UK time.
items.fit: Matches malaria risk modelling almost exactly.

items.title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship (ESOP)
items.fields: All ETH master's, e.g. Data Science, Statistics
items.funding: Living and study costs plus tuition waiver
eligibility: Top of class in your bachelor's
Apply for an ETH master's in the November window
items.deadline_note: Submit with your master's application by 23:59 CET.
items.fit: Route into ETH's MSc Data Science or Statistics.

items.title: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships
items.fields: Data Science, Computational Science, Environmental Sciences
items.funding: CHF 10,000 per semester for up to 4 semesters (partial funding)
eligibility: Apply on the EPFL master's application
items.deadline_note: For autumn 2027 entry.
items.fit: Strong data and environmental programmes for climate-health work.

items.title: KAUST MS/PhD Fellowship
items.provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
items.fields: Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Maths, Environmental Science
items.funding: Admitted students are normally fully funded — confirm on the offer
items.deadline_note: Round 2 for Fall 2027 (dates marked tentative). Decisions 25 February 2027.
items.fit: KAUST's spatio-temporal statistics group suits climate-malaria modelling.

items.title: France Excellence Eiffel 2027
items.fields: Includes Health and Mathematics & Digital Sciences
items.funding: Monthly allowance, travel, insurance, housing support
eligibility: Nominated by a French university — you cannot apply directly
Admission to a French master's or PhD
items.deadline_note: Universities' internal deadlines are earlier — contact programmes now.
items.fit: French master's in public health, epidemiology or data science.

items.title: Erasmus Mundus: Data Engineering and AI (DEAI)
items.funding: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: costs plus monthly allowance
eligibility: Relevant bachelor's in computing or data
items.deadline_note: Scholarship round opened 20 October; closes 12:00 GMT.
items.fit: Builds the engineering side of data work — useful for QuantAI-type tools.

items.title: Erasmus Mundus: Infectious Diseases and One Health (IDOH)
items.funding: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: costs plus monthly allowance
eligibility: Relevant bachelor's in health or life sciences
items.deadline_note: Portal opens 1 December 2026.
items.fit: Directly builds on malaria and infectious disease work.

items.title: UNICEF Ghana National Intern – Child Rights Monitoring
items.funding: Monthly stipend
eligibility: Master's in statistics, public policy or similar (or enrolled)
Graduated within two years is fine
items.deadline_note: Listed as open; no closing date shown — apply soon.
items.fit: Paid UN data internship in Ghana.

items.title: AI Solutions Architect – Code for Africa
eligibility: Degree in CS or data, or equivalent experience
3+ years building tools or AI workflows
items.deadline_note: Apply with CV and a one-page note.
items.fit: Remote pan-African role close to his QuantAI and web work.

items.title: Terumo BCT Africa Hackathon 2026
items.funding: USD 5,000 to the winner
eligibility: Working prototype with open or synthetic data
items.deadline_note: Closes 23:59 EAT. Showcase 13 November.
items.fit: A health data system build — dashboards and JavaScript apply directly.

items.title: CMU-Africa Master's (IT, Engineering AI, ECE)
items.fields: Information Technology, Engineering Artificial Intelligence, Electrical & Computer Engineering
items.funding: Financial aid for admitted African applicants, incl. Mastercard Foundation Scholars places (tuition, living costs, travel)
items.deadline_note: Early deadline 15 December 2026 (CMU-Africa pays test fees); final 15 January 2027. Submit the financial aid form after applying.
items.fit: US-accredited CS/AI master's in Africa that builds on his Soma and QuantAI work.

items.title: CMU-Africa Certificate in AI for Africa
items.fields: Python for AI, ML maths, machine learning, generative AI
items.funding: Free for selected applicants
eligibility: Basic linear algebra, probability and statistics
items.deadline_note: Cohort starts 17 January 2027. Date from listings — confirm on the CMU-Africa page.
items.fit: Free CMU credential that strengthens ML skills for QuantAI and grad applications.

items.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027/28
items.fields: All fields, incl. statistics, data science, public health
items.funding: HK$344,400/year stipend, tuition waiver at many universities, conference grant
eligibility: Apply to the RGC portal and a Hong Kong university
items.deadline_note: RGC initial application closes 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT; university forms close the same day.
items.fit: Well-funded PhD route for climate-malaria modelling at HKU or CUHK public health.

items.title: Google Africa Virtual Algorithms Workshop
items.funding: Free
eligibility: CS or engineering student, or recent graduate
items.deadline_note: Live session Saturday 31 October 2026, 12:00–14:00 GMT. Register before.
items.fit: Quick prep for tech job interviews.
